card.name: Capitalized warning-box wording
card.fires_on: Words inside all-caps boxed warnings, such as the end of ACUTE or CHRONIC before a condition, and REQUIRE after 'MAY' in hypersensitivity warnings.

modes.label: Split ACUTE/CHRONIC
modes.description: The last piece of ACUTE or CHRONIC in capitals, right before an organ failure or disease name.
modes.example: CASES OF AC<<UTE>> RENAL FAILURE RESULTING IN D

modes.label: MAY REQUIRE
modes.description: The word REQUIRE after MAY in all-caps hypersensitivity warnings that lead into epinephrine treatment.
modes.example: SERIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY<< REQUIRE>> EPINEPHRINE AND OTHER EM

card.writes: Heating words are promoted and 'he' words suppressed, which has no clear link to these warning texts.
card.plain: It fires on capitalized warning-box wording, like ACUTE liver failure or reactions that MAY REQUIRE epinephrine.
